prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in League City, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck and back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1007; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane of a multi-lane roadway in League City, Texas, when Driver 2 moved into the same lane without signaling and made contact with the left rear quarter panel of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 pulled onto the right shoulder after the impact. Driver 2 stopped nearby and stayed at the scene. Two independent witnesses who were in nearby vehicles described the lane change in the same way Driver 1 and Driver 2 did, and both said the collision happened as the drivers reported it. Photographs taken at the scene show damage to the left rear of Driver 1's vehicle and a matching mark on the right front of Driver 2's vehicle, consistent with a sideswipe. Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle, and both the responding officer and the witnesses confirmed that Passenger was present during the crash. Driver 1 reported neck and back pain, which is consistent with the forces involved in this type of impact. No prior damage to the vehicle was observed or reported. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle.
